note: Elephant's-toothpaste reagent descriptor stage (lower/nano band). Consumes the Geant4-probed solution and reacting-mixture densities and electron density (Geant4 sees the dissolved iodine/potassium in the catalyst solution and the oxygen-rich density of the peroxide solution) plus the declared recipe (peroxide mass fraction, soap mass fraction, KI molarity, catalyst volume fraction, initial temperature) and produces dimensionless mechanistic descriptors: peroxide reservoir capacity, iodide catalytic activity, surfactant film strength, and a temperature deviation factor. Inputs are standardised (input_mean/input_std) so the operating envelope is explicit. The reservoir/activity descriptors carry the Geant4 density/electron-density anchors so the response is tied to the real constructed material base, not just the recipe. This stage emits no completion time, eruption height, temperature, colour, or phase schedule; those emerge downstream from the integrated catalytic-decomposition model. It is an illustrative response surface (no measured hull); a wider trained catalytic-kinetics panel is tracked in ROADMAP.md.
